integrity: The derivation is analytic with exact-rational finite reproducibility checks; finite checks are not infinite proofs. No independent expert or formal validation and no definitive historical-priority determination are claimed.
limitations: Assumes three full-dimensional centrally symmetric convex slices with arithmetically aligned centers; does not solve unrestricted asymmetric or multi-slice centerpoint problems. Nonnested bodies retain a variational halfspace-cap discrepancy. The equal-mass one-third constant is an unattained infimum for d>=2, with no midpoint-inclusion hypothesis.
title: Exact halfspace-depth law for three symmetric convex slices and a sharp one-third bound
